scope: NIST DADS term pages for links plus independently written Chinese summaries only; excludes page prose, quotes, figures, linked code and third-party works

algo_counting_sort.note: Term page covers counting-sort mechanism; fact-check stability and complexity details separately.

algo_radix_sort.note: Term page describes LSD variant; draft also describes MSD processing. Add a source for that variant.

algo_bucket_sort.note: Term page covers bucket allocation, per-bucket sorting and concatenation.

algo_a_star.note: No matching A* term found in the NIST DADS index; replace with a precise, suitable source before release.

algo_kruskal.note: Term page supports minimum-spanning-tree selection, but draft's disjoint-set implementation and complexity need supporting source.

algo_lcs.note: Entry expressly credits the Algorithms and Theory of Computation Handbook, copyright 1999 CRC Press LLC. Not NIST public-domain text. The page defines LCS but does not support draft's DP recurrence; replace or supplement with an independently usable exact source. No text was imported.

ds_deque.note: Term page covers operations at both ends.

ds_circular_buffer.note: The indexed NIST entry is circular queue, not circular buffer; it defines a bounded array-backed queue but not the draft's wraparound, read/write positions or streaming use. Replace or supplement source.

ds_skip_list.note: Term page covers randomized layered ordered lists and search; linked third-party diagrams/code excluded.

ds_bloom_filter.note: Term page covers bit array, multiple hashes and membership test; linked implementations/figures excluded.

ds_adjacency_matrix.note: Term page covers graph matrix representation and weighted/undirected cases; linked code excluded.

policy_note: NIST credits notice distinguishes public-domain definitions from CRC Press copyrighted exceptions. A term page must be examined individually; this review does not grant publication clearance.
